name: GoodBox
shortDescription: A UK charity fundraising platform for contactless donation devices, online giving and a data portal.
suitableContexts: UK churches and charities seeking managed contactless giving devices
Buildings, events and visitor locations where in-person giving matters

pricing.summary: GoodBox says signup is free and publishes a UK transaction fee of 1.59% plus 10p per donation. Devices can be purchased, leased or hired; the detailed hardware price list requires a request.

tiers.label: Account signup
tiers.detail: Supplier states signup is quick, easy and free

tiers.label: Devices
tiers.detail: Purchase, lease and hire options are stated; detailed prices require the brochure

editorial.assessment: GoodBox is a UK fundraising technology option rather than church management software. It may suit a church with visitor, event or building-based giving needs, but the decision should include device cost, placement, connectivity, transaction fees and the finance team’s reconciliation process.
bestFor: Churches needing physical contactless donation points
Teams that want device supply and a fundraising-data portal
limitations: Detailed hardware price list is not public
Gift Aid and church-specific finance workflow are not confirmed here

longForm.verdict: GoodBox is best assessed as a contactless-fundraising implementation, not simply an online account. Its usefulness depends on whether device placement and donor experience justify the hardware and transaction cost.

decisionLens.heading: Treat the device as part of the church environment.
decisionLens.text: A contactless unit needs power or charging, connectivity, physical security, clear donation prompts and somebody who owns reporting. Estimate the likely use at each location before choosing purchase, lease or hire.

sections.heading: Contactless giving in real spaces
sections.question: Will a device earn its place in the building or at events?
paragraphs: GoodBox describes contactless devices, online giving and access to a data portal. Its pricing page states that devices can be purchased, leased or hired.

Ask for the hardware brochure, then run the treasurer through a test donation and report. Confirm whether the expected transaction fee, settlement timing and donor information will fit the church’s accounting and Gift Aid process.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on GoodBox’s official pricing and charity-fundraising pages.
themes: The device model and site conditions determine practical value.
The stated transaction fee is only one part of total cost.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier descriptions do not establish the suitability or return on investment of a device at a particular church.

faq.question: What does GoodBox charge?
faq.answer: GoodBox publishes a UK transaction fee of 1.59% plus 10p per donation. Device prices are supplied through its pricing brochure.

faq.question: Can a church lease or hire GoodBox devices?
faq.answer: Yes. GoodBox states that contactless devices can be purchased, leased or hired.

faq.question: Does GoodBox support Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Not confirmed in this profile. Ask GoodBox to demonstrate the declaration and reporting flow needed by the church.

seo.title: GoodBox review for UK churches
seo.description: Independent GoodBox profile for UK churches: contactless giving, transaction fees, device options and finance checks.
